story: A strong breakaway formed after 35 kilometres, featuring riders including Pepijn Reinderink, Leo Hayter and Nils Politt. A group of general classification contenders bridged across with 60 kilometres remaining, creating a 19-man lead group. After several attacks, Reinderink made the decisive move on the penultimate climb and soloed to his first professional victory. Davide Piganzoli, who had bridged to the front, finished second and took the overall race lead.
